_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'English Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Topics 12.1-12.5. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. Topics 12.5.3 ('Verbs Followed by Object + Infinitive') and 12.5.4 ('Verbs Followed by Object + Infinitive', covering verbs of sensation) are printed in the source with the same sub-topic heading despite being distinct entries with distinct example verbs; both are reproduced here as separate sub-topics per the source's own numbering (12.5.3 and 12.5.4). The document ends after 12.5.6 (Intensifiers/Adverbs of Degree) — the remaining pages of the source PDF (73-75) are blank, confirming this is the final topic of the entire Grade 10-12 English syllabus, with no practical/appendix section (unlike some other subjects in this curriculum). The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here.
